entities.summary: Anne Fleur Dekker is a Dutch publicist, feminist and journalist. Dekker has written opinion pieces and blogs for politically left-wing websites and magazines, and has been an activist for several causes. She is a former GroenLinks party employee in Hilversum. Anne Fleur Dekker was a journalists & chroniclers from Blaricum (b. 1994-04-28, Blaricum). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
